_comment: Mock GPT-4o response for Polymarket Consensus Bundling. Used by Gate 2 Gold tests (Section 4.4 / 4.2A). Represents the JSON that call_openai_consensus() parses from choices[0].message.content.
executive_summary: Community consensus leans YES (67%) on a Fed rate cut before June 2026, driven by softening inflation data and a cooling labor market. However, sticky core PCE and hawkish Powell rhetoric sustain a meaningful NO cohort, keeping the market at elevated uncertainty.
key_findings: Macro traders favour YES at 0.73, citing soft CPI and jobs data as primary catalysts
Core PCE remains sticky — the principal risk factor underpinning the NO thesis
T10Y2Y reversal back to positive cited as a contra-indicator against premature rate cuts
